tex_content.label: nolocalcollapse
tex_content.html: For $n,T,\rho ,K,c>0$, there is $\kappa =\kappa (n,K,c,\rho ,T)>0$ such that any complete flow on $[0,T)$ with compact-time curvature bounds, $|\Rm |(g(0))\le K$, and $\inj (g(0))\ge c$ is $\kappa $-noncollapsed on scale $\rho $. With the other parameters fixed, $\kappa $ is nonincreasing in $T$.
